referee_caveats_inferred: The planet-mass limit depends on alpha_turb = 1e-3 and on the Tanaka et al. 2022 equation (18) chosen as the conservative of two criteria; the h/r of 0.079 comes from a simulation paper
Free-free interpretation of the central source rests on alpha < 2 and an unresolved size with a degenerate width/intensity fit; Liu et al. 2024 find free-free not dominant
Ring center versus central source offset is limited by fit uncertainty of ~1.5 au, so e < 0.04 is a weak constraint relative to the 75 au ring radius
Band 7 and Band 3 images were aligned on the fitted ring center, which could bias the spectral index near the ring if alignment errors exist
